arguments.prompt: Close insert on new pine decking. Work boots take two slow steps along the fresh boards, then a gloved hand sweeps sawdust off the square edge of the platform with a hand brush, the dust falling in the low raking winter sun. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. Shallow depth of field on the boards and the boots. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
